subject: prd/implement-now
statement: If a configured review is interrupted, fails infrastructure, produces no authenticated exact artifact, or remains pending when a later invocation has no ready implementation task, then the system shall retain the immutable exact-green obligation, release all implementation resources, append the typed three-way failed attempt when one occurred, exact-read before any selected retry, and let the driver perform only consumer-bounded FR-46 review-only invocations; never re-derive a head, widen the selected frontier, redispatch succeeded implementation, or report clean while a selected obligation remains pending
intent: implementation stays succeeded; the review obligation stays pending/run-red as `artifact_unverified`, `artifact_untrusted`, or `infrastructure` until authenticated verification; consumer recovery exhaustion remains explicit outside the provider
fit_criterion: kill, auth, factory, route, runtime, truncation, malformed/absent artifact, forgery/replay, transport, selected empty-frontier restart, and exhausted-driver-budget fixtures retain exact obligations, launch zero implementation, never touch unselected obligations, keep one closed failure class, and exit 1 until every selected member verifies
